sample.question:
The image shows a six-face cube net. The cube starts with U on top, F in front, and R on the right. A roll north/east/south/west moves the cube in that direction without twisting.
The cube rolls in this order: west, south, west, east. Which emblem finishes on top?
A. Cross
B. Circle
C. Sun
D. Diamond
E. Bars
F. Triangle
sample.analysis: Track the orientation after each roll ['west', 'south', 'west', 'east']. The final top face is B, carrying the Sun emblem. The answer is C.
